sessions.prompt:
Add parse_duration(s) to units.py: a duration in minutes such as "30m" becomes an int (30). Add tests.

The plan for parse_duration has one more step: it also accepts hours and minutes ("1h15m") and clock form ("1:15"); both are 75. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): a workout lasts a whole number of minutes from 1 to 300: any function given another duration raises ValueError.

Design decision for this project: running burns 60 calories per km.

given.handoff: Session 1 added parse_duration(s) with tests. Its last step is left for later: accept 1h15m and 1:15.
decisions: A workout lasts a whole number of minutes from 1 to 300; another duration raises ValueError in any function.

sessions.prompt:
Add a Log class to log.py: add(day, kind, minutes, km=0) records a workout on a datetime.date, entries(day) returns that day's workouts as (kind, minutes, km) tuples in the order they were added, and total(kind=None) returns the total minutes, of one kind or of all. Add tests.

Project rule (it applies to all later work too): the kinds are "run", "bike" and "swim"; kinds ignore case and are stored in lower case, and any other kind raises ValueError in any function.

Design decision for this project: weeks start on Monday.

Design decision for this project: each line of a summary has the form 2026-06-01 run 30m.

given.handoff: Session 2 added Log.add, entries and total with tests.
decisions: Kinds are run, bike, swim; they ignore case, are stored lower case, and any other kind raises ValueError.
A summary line has the form 2026-06-01 run 30m.

sessions.prompt:
Add Log.days() to log.py: the sorted list of days with workouts. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): weeks start on Sunday, not Monday.

Design decision for this project: a second workout of the same kind on the same day is merged into the first: its minutes and km are added.

Design decision for this project: swimming burns 10 calories per minute, whatever the distance.

decisions: Supersedes Monday: weeks start on Sunday.
A second workout of the same kind on the same day is merged: minutes and km are added.
Swimming burns 10 calories per minute, whatever the distance.

sessions.prompt:
Add Log.kinds() to log.py: the kinds that have workouts, in the order they first appeared. Add tests.

The plan for Log.kinds has one more step: they are sorted by total minutes, most first. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): running burns 70 calories per km, not 60.

given.handoff: Session 4 added Log.kinds() with tests. Its last step is left for later: sort by total minutes, most first.
decisions: Supersedes 60: running burns 70 calories per km.

sessions.prompt:
Add streak(log, today) to stats.py: the number of days in the unbroken run of workout days that ends today (0 when today has no workout). Add tests.

The plan for streak has one more step: a single rest day between two workout days does not break the streak; the rest day itself is not counted. Do not do that step now; leave it for a later session.

given.handoff: Session 5 added streak(log, today) with tests. Its last step is left for later: a single rest day does not break the streak and is not counted.

sessions.prompt:
Add week_total(log, day) to stats.py: the total minutes in the week that contains day. Add tests.

Change to an earlier decision (it replaces the old one): each line of a summary has the form 2026-06-01 Run: 30 min, not 2026-06-01 run 30m.

Design decision for this project: a summary lists the days newest first.

Design decision for this project: the last line of a summary is the total, in the form Total: 95 min.

given.handoff: Session 6 added week_total(log, day) with tests.
decisions: Supersedes 2026-06-01 run 30m: a summary line has the form 2026-06-01 Run: 30 min.
A summary lists the days newest first.
The last summary line is the total: Total: 95 min.

sessions.prompt: Add calories(kind, minutes, km) to stats.py: the calories (an int) burned in one workout. Cycling burns 30 calories per km. Add tests.
